name: Fire Scales
cardTexts: At the start of player's turn, burn 1 random card from inventory
erratas: The start of the round is determined by the player who goes first.
Fire Scales effect can be affected by other card effects.
Card Interactions:
- Cards discarded by Fire Scales count towards Princess' Distress Quest
Expansions Interactions:
- Mythical Monsters: When Dragon has Chimera, Fire Scales always targets the highest value treasure first. When Player has Chimera, Fire Scales does not affect your highest value treasure(s)

name: Water Tail
cardTexts: +1 to all treasure card danger levels
erratas: There is no maximum danger level.

name: Thunder Talons
erratas: Expansions Interactions:
- Characters: Paladin can negate this effect

name: Earth Horns
cardTexts: Dragon wins all ties for contests
erratas: Whenever a contest roll happens and the result is tied, the Dragon gets an automatic win instead of rerolling.

name: Wind Crest
cardTexts: On an encounter loss: Move all negative treasure to random player inventories
erratas: Determine where the negative treasure cards get moved towards through a die roll.

name: The King's Crown
cardTexts: The King's Command: Thou shalt use five different items
The King's Crown: You may use any item as if it were your own
erratas: To add a counter to The King's Commands quest, you need to use a unique item. Using the same item twice will only count towards the quest once.
When used, you can choose any item in any player's inventory or in the Dragon's hoard.
You may use The King's Crown when it is not your turn.
You may only use The King's Crown effect on an untapped item.
The effect of the chosen item gets resolved as if you are using the item yourself.
When The King's Crown is used to use an item's effect that has 1️⃣ One usage, then that item is discarded after use instead of The King's Crown

name: The Prince's Horn
cardTexts: The Prince's Adventure: Thou shalt emerge victorious across three wagers
The Prince's Horn: You may reroll any of your dice with values less than 3
erratas: You may reroll dice with base value of 1 and 2 indefinitely during your turn across different encounters and wagers.

name: The Queen's Ring
cardTexts: The Queen's Favour: Thou shalt collect four unique treasures.
The Queen's Ring: All treasures in your inventory have added +100 value
erratas: Negative treasures count towards the quest counter.
Multiple of the same treasures will only count towards the quest counter once. when you lose a treasure due to a card's effect  the counter goes down as well.
When The Queen's Favour quest is chosen and you already have 4 or more unique treasures, you immediately gain The Queen's Ring

name: The Knight's Gauntlet
cardTexts: The Knight's Journey: Thou shalt prevail two encounters against the dragon
The Knight's Gauntlet: x2 to the effect of any item card in your inventory
erratas: The effect of The Knight's Gauntlet does not affect other quest items.

name: The Princess' Chalice
cardTexts: The Princess' Distress: Thou shalt discard six cards from your inventory
The Princess' Chalice: Each time you discard a card, draw a card of the same type
erratas: Discarding one usage items after using them counts towards The Princess' Distress quest counter.
Drawing a treasure card due to The Princess' Chalice effect will not trigger an encounter. You may choose which treasure deck to draw from.
Expansions Interactions:
- Mythical Monsters: When player uses Lich, player may draw from the discard pile instead, effectively gaining back your lost card.
